title: A Sky From a Window
paragraphs: In eighteen eighty nine, the painter Vincent van Gogh lived in a hospital in the south of France. He was unwell, and he stayed there for about a year. The hospital was quiet and the nights were long. From his window, he could see the morning sky before sunrise.

That view gave him the idea for a famous painting, The Starry Night. In the picture, big stars shine and the sky moves in bright blue and yellow circles. Under the sky, a quiet village sleeps. Many people love this picture because the colours feel so alive.

Van Gogh did not only copy what he saw. He also used his imagination, his memories and his feelings. Today, the painting is in a museum in New York, and many people come to see it. Each visitor sees something a little different.
